title: Quiet Friday close · whole range
request: Give me a version of Quiet Friday close that uses whole-range containment.
meaning: The anchor closes in the selected tail of a Friday NYSE regular session. The high minus the low across the whole trailing window is at most width_max times the anchor close.

params.name: last
params.doc: elapsed time before the NYSE close

params.name: quiet_for
params.doc: length of the whole trailing range

params.name: width_max
params.doc: maximum whole-range width as a share of the anchor close

body: weekday(nyse_regular) = fri and session_tail(nyse_regular, last: last) and range_contained(over: quiet_for, width_max: width_max)
label: Friday NYSE close, last {last}, whole {quiet_for} range ≤ {width_max}
availability: Uses the pinned calendar and bars completed by the anchor.
missing: A known false condition excludes the anchor. Otherwise missing required history or calendar coverage yields unknown.
replay: The explicit v2 call pins the whole-range definition. The unqualified v1 call retains rolling-range persistence.

conformance.note: The whole 48h range spans 4.98% of the close.
The same recorded range fits the wider threshold.
The half-hour tail starts strictly after this close.
The NYSE was closed on Good Friday.
The New York date precedes calendar coverage and the recording lacks earlier bars.
